'''Red''' can refer to the following:
==Groups==
*The ''[[Aethan Dor]]'' - an [[Aiel]] [[Aiel warrior societies|warrior society]], meening "Red Shields" in the [[Old Tongue]].
*The [[Band of the Red Hand]] - an army led by [[Matrim Cauthon]].
* [[Redarm]] - the policing force of the Band.
*The [[Red Ajah]] - the largest [[Ajah]] among the [[Aes Sedai]].
*[[Red Springs Hold]] - clan hold of the [[Codarra]] Aiel.
* [[Red Salt]] - a [[sept]] of the [[Goshien]] Aiel.
* [[Red Water]] - a sept of the Goshien Aiel.

==''[[Ter'angreal]]''==
*A [[brilliant red rod]] - a ''ter'angreal'' in the possession of [[Alviarin Freidhen]].
*A [[red crystal chair]] - a ''ter'angreal'' found in [[Rhuidean]].
*A [[red rod]] - a ''ter'angreal'' found in [[Ebou Dar]].
*A [[red stone bracelet]] - a ''ter'angreal'' in the possession of [[Nynaeve al'Meara]].

==Plants and [[herbs]]==
*[[Red cockleburr]] - a type of plant.
* [[Red daisy]] - a bitter herb.
* [[Red fennel]] - an herb that calms an upset stomach.

==Others==
*''[[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 17|The Red Sister]]'' - the seventeenth chapter of ''[[The Dragon Reborn]]''.
*''[[Lord of Chaos/Chapter 31|Red Wax]]'' - the thirty-first chapter of ''[[Lord of Chaos]]''.
*[[Red (horse)|Red]] - a horse riden by [[Rand al'Thor]].
*[[Redwing]] - a horse owned by [[Medore Damara]].
* [[Red Hawk Takes a Dove]] - a [[sword form]].
